title: The Full Interrogation
blurb: All three rounds with the sorceress, back to back. A minute of cat and mouse.

characters.name: Circe
characters.description: The sorceress of Aiaia. Sharp-eyed, amused, dangerous.

characters.name: Odysseus
characters.description: Starving, armed, and lying about who he is.

lines.text: You say you're all alone,… but no one comes here alone.
lines.direction: Circle him slowly. You already know the answer.
Raise an eyebrow. Give nothing away.

lines.text: You can only reach this spot by sea. So where are your shipmates?
lines.direction: Lean in. Tap the table with one finger.

lines.text: I'm looking for them. Anyone happen to come this way?
lines.direction: Hold her gaze. Keep your voice even.

lines.text: But you prepared all this food.
lines.direction: Gesture at the feast. Turn the question back on her.
Sit back, offended. Then laugh once.

lines.text: A traveler who's clearly starving, yet hasn't touched the food in front of him, claims to be a sailor, yet wears a great warrior's armor.
lines.direction: Count his lies on your fingers. Savor each one.

lines.text: And who breaks Zeus's law… by bringing a dagger into his hostess's house.
lines.direction: Point at the dagger. Your smile is gone.
A slow nod. Respect, and a warning.
Let the pause hang. Look away, then back.

lines.text: Would they tell you where I could find my men?
lines.direction: Your voice cracks a little. You need this.
Almost begging. Hands open on the table.
Hold out your hand, palm up. Wait for the dagger.

lines.text: If you give me your dagger.
lines.direction: Hold out your hand, palm up. Wait for the dagger.

source: The Odyssey (2026 film); OBS screen recording, transcribed with ElevenLabs Scribe v2 (diarized)
